fieldValues.title: Curation has to come before memory
fieldValues.summary: A topic filed under the wrong subject leaves the right subject's chain without a predecessor; the process found both misfilings but may not move them, so a person's acceptance sits between minutes and update.
evidence: Fire escape standing as of November superseded nothing until October's topic was moved
Two proposals at each meeting, both correct, none applied by the process
fieldValues.body: The order is minutes, the secretary's check, curation, update, merge. Curation is a clerk session act.
